title: Fix the lore check schema drift under .lore/schemas
description: lore check exits 6 on dev with 11 schema-drift errors under .lore/schemas/. Ten say the committed schema no longer matches what the active profile generates (epic, arc, story, spec, adr, runbook, reference, constitution, constants, attested-computation); one (standard) says the active profile declares a type with no committed schema. Every line says to run lore schema export. Found while building PES-10 (#45); no .lore or docs file is touched by that PR, so the drift is pre-existing and independent of the PES-3..PES-10 work.

acceptanceCriteria.text: lore check exits 0 on the branch that delivers this task
No error line in lore check output names schema-drift
The drift is closed at its source - regenerate the schemas with lore schema export, or correct the profile or CLI version that generates them - never by suppressing or masking the check
No unrelated docs content rides along

finalSummary:
Fixed the pre-existing lore check red. lore schema export regenerated the eleven committed schemas under .lore/schemas/: ten rewritten (adr, arc, attested-computation, constants, constitution, epic, reference, runbook, spec, story) and one new (standard), which the active built-in profile declares and no schema had been committed for. lore check now exits 0 with 0 errors, down from exit 6 with 11 schema-drift errors.

Closed at the source, as the criterion requires: the remedy is the one lore check itself names (run lore schema export), not a suppression. The profile file .lore/profile.toml is the commented-out default, so the bundle follows the built-in type vocabulary; the committed schemas had simply been generated by an older lore release than the installed 0.13.0.

No unrelated content rides along: the only files touched are .lore/schemas/ and this task record. This was blocking PES-9, whose acceptance criterion is lore check exiting 0 on a docs change.

Gates: lore check exit 0, 24 files, 0 errors, 0 warnings; npm --prefix harness test 262 pass / 0 fail; claude plugin test 21/21; claude plugin validate exit 0; node src/cli.mjs audit exit 0, all 12 checks agree.
